scams.name: Brasília (BSB) Airport Taxi & Late-Night Transfer Overcharge
scams.description:
Brasília's Aeroporto Juscelino Kubitschek (BSB) is 12 km from central Plano Piloto (the Lúcio Costa planned-city core) and 10 km from the Eixo Monumental + Esplanada dos Ministérios (the federal government monument corridor). Despite being a capital-city airport, 2025 late-night arrivals show a recurring taxi + rideshare overcharge pattern.

Legitimate 2026 cost: Uber / 99 / Cabify from BSB to Asa Sul hotels (Carlton, Kubitschek Plaza, Grand Mercure) R$40–R$65 (20 min); to Asa Norte R$50–R$75 (25 min); to the Setor Hoteleiro Sul (SHS) R$35–R$55 (15 min); to Lago Sul (upmarket residential + embassies) R$70–R$110 (30 min); to Plano Piloto's Eixo Monumental (Congresso Nacional, Palácio do Planalto) R$45–R$65 (20 min). Budget public: the Ônibus 'Executivo Aeroporto-Rodoviária' links BSB to the Rodoviária do Plano Piloto at R$5.00 per person (40 min), runs 5 AM–11 PM. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) 'Taxi Comum' rank outside BSB quotes 'flat R$180 to Asa Sul' (real Uber R$40–R$65); (b) 'Special Taxi' / 'Taxi Executivo' kiosks quoting R$200–R$350 to Plano Piloto; (c) late-night arrivals (after midnight) — BSB has many congressional / business flights arriving 11 PM–2 AM; Uber wait times spike to 15–30 min and unlicensed drivers fill the gap; (d) Uber driver refusing in-app price after pickup, demanding cash top-up R$50 'because airport surcharge' — Uber Brazil has no airport surcharge; (e) hotel-arranged transfer at 30–50% markup vs Uber (hotel R$140, Uber R$50); (f) fake 'official Brasília tourism airport tour-desk' selling combined 'airport transfer + city-tour R$400' — real DIY: Uber + DIY walking of Eixo Monumental = R$60; (g) for late-night arrivals, some BSB taxis demand a 'night surcharge R$80' — legitimate night-surcharge is limited to 20% over daytime meter; (h) mototaxi street offers at the arrivals curbside — do NOT use with luggage or as a tourist.

For travelers: (1) book Uber / 99 / Cabify on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage; (2) meet driver at the designated 'Aplicativos' pickup zone — at BSB this is on the Upper Level Pick-Up / Desembarque Nível Superior (follow 'Aplicativos' signs from the arrivals hall, NOT 'Taxi' ranks); (3) for late-night arrivals (after 11 PM), pre-book a transfer via your hotel or Brasília Transfers at R$80–R$150 fixed — worth avoiding Uber-wait frustration in an unfamiliar city; (4) Ignore every 'Taxi Comum' / 'Special Taxi' quote inside the terminal above R$100 — those are the overcharge operation; (5) Don't hand a credit card to any taxi driver; (6) if your Uber driver demands cash top-up for 'airport surcharge', refuse + cancel in-app + use in-app safety button (there is no Uber Brazil airport surcharge); (7) for return to BSB, pre-book Uber the night before from your hotel — saves 20 min of pickup friction; (8) DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522 (Polícia Militar Turística, some English); Polícia Militar 190, SAMU 192. Book Uber, 99, or Cabify on airport Wi-Fi after luggage — meet driver at the Upper Level "Aplicativos" pickup zone, NOT the "Taxi" rank. Refuse every "Taxi Comum" or "Special Taxi" quote above R$100 (real Uber to Asa Sul is R$40–R$65). For late-night arrivals (after 11 PM), pre-book Brasília Transfers R$80–R$150 fixed instead of fighting Uber wait times. Refuse every "airport surcharge" cash top-up — Uber Brazil has no such fee — and never hand a card to a taxi driver. Save DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522 for tourist-police backup.
scams.avoidance: Uber / 99 / Cabify from BSB to Asa Sul R$40–R$65; to Asa Norte R$50–R$75 Meet driver at 'Aplicativos' zone on Upper Level Pick-Up (signposted) Late-night (after 11 PM): pre-book Brasília Transfers R$80–R$150 fixed IGNORE every 'Taxi' rank quote above R$100; NEVER hand card to driver DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522; Polícia Militar 190; SAMU 192
scams.location: Aeroporto Juscelino Kubitschek (BSB), arrivals hall, curbside pickup
scams.tldr: BSB airport taxi/kiosk operators quote flat R$180–R$350 to Plano Piloto/Asa Sul (real Uber R$40–R$65), with hotel-arranged transfers at 30–50% markup and unlicensed late-night drivers (after 11 PM) demanding fake R$80 "airport surcharges."

scams.name: Esplanada dos Ministérios & Congresso Nacional Pickpocket & 'Tourist Guide' Scam
scams.description:
Brasília's Praça dos Três Poderes (Esplanada dos Ministérios, Congresso Nacional, STF supreme court, and Catedral Metropolitana) is the city's mandatory tourist circuit — and 2025 'tourist guide' scams plus phone-snatch incidents cluster around the Three Powers Plaza.

The 2025 scam patterns: (a) 'official tourist guide R$80–R$150' offered on the Esplanada by someone claiming Cadastur license — MOST are unlicensed; legitimate guides carry a visible Cadastur ID card, are listed in Brasília's tourism office database, and cost R$200–R$350 for a 2-hour tour (book via the official SETURC tourism office at www.turismobrasilia.com.br); (b) phone-snatch on the Esplanada walk — tourists take photos of the twin ministry buildings or Oscar Niemeyer's Congresso 'bowl' roof, a pedestrian or cyclist snatches the phone; (c) 'cadeira de roda acessível' (accessible chair) tourist-desk scam at the Catedral Metropolitana — offers to 'rent' a wheelchair R$100 for a 10-min cathedral visit (the Catedral has free accessibility assistance — request at reception); (d) 'mandatory Congresso Nacional tour R$60' offered in the parking area — the actual Palácio do Congresso guided tour is free (weekdays 10 AM, 11 AM, 3 PM; book at tours.congresso.leg.br 1–5 days ahead, bring passport); (e) 'exclusive Palácio da Alvorada tour R$200' — the Presidential residence Alvorada is currently closed to public tours per 2025 SFP security policy; 'exclusive' offers are fraudulent; (f) 'Brasília by night tour R$350 per person' with kickback commission stops at souvenir shops + overpriced Lago Paranoá restaurants (real DIY: Uber to Pontão Lago Sul sunset + Juscelino Kubitschek bridge photo R$40 round-trip); (g) Praça dos Três Poderes 'model photo' scam — 'take your picture with this historical flag R$50' using a regular Brazilian flag; (h) at the Catedral Metropolitana, 'mandatory donation R$30' demanded at the entrance — the cathedral is free; a voluntary donation box is inside the nave.

For travelers: (1) for guided Esplanada tours, book via official SETURC tourism office (www.turismobrasilia.com.br) at R$200–R$350 for 2 hours — Refuse every street-approach 'guide' offer; (2) the Congresso Nacional guided tour is free — book at tours.congresso.leg.br 1–5 days ahead (English tours available on request), bring passport for security check; (3) for the Palácio do Planalto, free guided tours on Sundays 9:30 AM–1:30 PM only — book at www.planalto.gov.br/presidencia/visita; (4) carry decoy phone + R$100 cash for the Esplanada walk; leave passport + cards in hotel safe; take photos QUICKLY then stow phone; (5) at the Catedral Metropolitana, entry is free (voluntary donation box inside nave) — Refuse every 'mandatory donation' at entrance; (6) for the Lago Paranoá sunset + Juscelino Kubitschek bridge (a genuinely beautiful Brasília experience), Uber R$40–R$60 round-trip from Asa Sul — skip every 'private night tour R$350' offer; (7) for travelers, the gold-standard 1-day Brasília circuit: morning Catedral (9 AM) + Itamaraty Palace (guided tour Wed/Thu/Fri 2:30 PM, free with booking) + Esplanada walk + Congresso tour + lunch at Setor de Clubes Sul (Veleiros, Asa Delta, Pontão waterfront) + afternoon Memorial JK (tomb of Kubitschek, R$10) + sunset at Pontão; (8) DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522; Polícia Militar 190; SAMU 192. Book Esplanada guides ONLY via the official SETURC tourism office (turismobrasilia.com.br) at R$200–R$350 for 2 hours — refuse every street-approach "guide" offer. The Congresso Nacional tour is FREE via tours.congresso.leg.br (English available, 1–5 days ahead, bring passport); Catedral entry is FREE (voluntary donation inside only). Carry a decoy phone + R$100 cash on the Esplanada walk; leave passport and cards in the hotel safe; take photos quickly and stow phone. Refuse every "exclusive Palácio Alvorada tour" or "all-inclusive Sep 7 parade viewing" offer — both are public-access free events.
scams.avoidance: Book guide via official SETURC www.turismobrasilia.com.br R$200–R$350 for 2 hours Congresso tour FREE via tours.congresso.leg.br; Planalto FREE Sun 9:30 AM–1:30 PM Catedral entry FREE (voluntary donation inside only); Itamaraty guided Wed/Thu/Fri 2:30 PM Decoy phone + R$100 cash on Esplanada; passport + cards in hotel safe DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522; Polícia Militar 190
scams.location: Esplanada dos Ministérios, Congresso Nacional, Praça dos Três Poderes, Catedral Metropolitana
scams.tldr: Unlicensed "official tourist guides" on the Esplanada dos Ministérios and Praça dos Três Poderes charge R$80–R$150 (real Cadastur-licensed R$200–R$350); phone-snatch crews target older photo-takers; "mandatory" donations are demanded at the free Catedral; and "exclusive Palácio Alvorada tours" are wholly fraudulent (Alvorada is closed).

scams.name: Brasília Restaurant Couvert + Serviço Padding & 'Comida por Kg' Weighing Trap
scams.description:
Brasília's dining culture is dominated by weekday 'comida por kg' (pay-by-weight) lunch buffets and upscale Asa Sul / Asa Norte dinner restaurants. The pay-by-weight format is a 2025 tourist-overcharge vector alongside the standard couvert + serviço patterns.

Brazilian restaurant law (Lei 13.419/2017) makes the 10% serviço charge OPTIONAL. INMETRO (the Brazilian metrology institute) regulates commercial scales — the 'comida por kg' buffet MUST display an INMETRO-certified scale with the certification sticker visible. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) 'comida por kg' buffet with UNCERTIFIED scale padding weight by 10–25% — legitimate Asa Sul lunch buffet R$70–R$110 per kg (reputable: Fogo de Chão Asa Sul, Porcão Brasília, Universal Diner); (b) 'bebida sem conta' (drink without itemised receipt) — R$15 bottled water or R$25 refresco added to plate-weight then billed opaquely; (c) couvert artístico R$40–R$100 per person at Asa Sul + Asa Norte upscale (legitimate R$20–R$40 for a genuine Brasília MPB / samba musician); (d) 'serviço 10%' added silently + menu shows 'serviço opcional' fine print; (e) credit-card surcharge 5–10% at bill-time ('we prefer PIX'); (f) at Pontão Lago Sul waterfront restaurants, 'view surcharge R$30 per person' added silently; (g) tourist-zone Setor Comercial Sul lunch kg-buffet charging R$180 per kg (double regional rate) — check posted R$/kg BEFORE sitting; (h) 'couvert + música ao vivo R$80' bundled as mandatory at bars like Bar Brasília (can be refused by leaving early).

For travelers: (1) at 'comida por kg' buffets, VERIFY the scale has a visible INMETRO certification sticker (valid 1 year, stamped Inmetro Calibração 2025/2026) — if missing, walk out; (2) BEFORE plating, check posted R$ per kg price (legitimate 2026 Brasília lunch R$70–R$110 per kg); reputable kg-buffets in Asa Sul: Universal Diner (lunch R$85/kg), Zuu aA (R$95/kg), Buffet Estoril (R$80/kg); (3) drinks are SEPARATE from the plate-weight — ask 'bebida está separada?' BEFORE you fill water / refresco; pay for drinks at the separate counter; (4) BEFORE sitting at dinner restaurants, confirm couvert artístico R$ + serviço policy + card surcharge IN WRITING; photograph menu; (5) reputable Asa Sul dinner: Mangai (Northeastern, Google 4.5+, R$100–R$180), Bar Brasília (iconic chope + petiscos, R$80–R$160), Fogo de Chão Brasília (rodízio, R$200–R$280); reputable Lago Sul: Veleiros (waterfront, R$100–R$200), Barranco Bar & Restaurante; (6) Refuse 'view surcharge' at Pontão — the view is free, the restaurant charges for food not scenery; (7) if serviço is added against your wishes for poor service, politely Refuse and cite Lei 13.419/2017; (8) PROCON-DF 151 for billing disputes; DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522. At "comida por kg" buffets, verify the visible INMETRO certification sticker on the scale (valid 1 year, stamped Inmetro Calibração 2025/2026) — walk out if missing. Check posted R$/kg before plating (legitimate R$70–R$110/kg in Brasília); ask "bebida está separada?" to keep drinks off plate-weight; pay drinks at the separate counter. Reputable kg-buffets: Universal Diner, Zuu aA, Buffet Estoril; reputable dinner: Mangai, Bar Brasília, Fogo de Chão. Refuse silent 10% serviço under Lei 13.419/2017 and refuse "view surcharge" at Pontão — call PROCON-DF 151 for disputes.
scams.avoidance: VERIFY INMETRO certification sticker on kg-buffet scale BEFORE plating Check posted R$/kg (legitimate Brasília lunch R$70–R$110/kg); ask drinks separate Reputable kg: Universal Diner / Zuu aA / Buffet Estoril; dinner: Mangai / Bar Brasília Confirm couvert + serviço + card surcharge IN WRITING; photograph menu REFUSE serviço for poor service (Lei 13.419/2017); PROCON-DF 151
scams.location: Asa Sul / Asa Norte restaurant districts, Setor Comercial Sul / Norte lunch strips
scams.tldr: Brasília restaurants pad bills via uncertified "comida por kg" buffet scales (10–25% weight inflation), drink-bundled-into-plate-weight tricks, R$40–R$100 inflated couvert artístico (legitimate R$20–R$40), and silent 10% serviço — Lei 13.419/2017 makes the serviço optional.

scams.name: Brasília Aluguel de Temporada (Airbnb) & Hotel Booking Fraud (Peak Dates)
scams.description:
Brasília's peak accommodation dates cluster around Independência (Sep 7 military parade on the Esplanada), Réveillon (the Pontão Lago Sul fireworks display), and government-calendar events (posses presidenciais every 4 years, large congressional sessions). The accommodation landscape mixes Plano Piloto hotels with Asa Sul / Lago Sul Airbnbs and Park Way suburban houses — all vulnerable to cancel-and-relist plus PIX-deposit fraud.

The 2025–2026 scam patterns: (a) Airbnb cancel-and-relist — host accepts your Independência booking 6 months out at R$350/night, cancels 30 days before the dates citing 'electricity emergency' / 'family illness' / 'host incapacitated' — re-lists the same unit at R$900/night immediately; Airbnb refunds the original payment but you are scrambling 30 days out with peak-season pricing; (b) Instagram / WhatsApp 'aluguel temporada Brasília' sellers demanding PIX-transfer deposit — Brazilian PIX is IRREVERSIBLE, and the listing disappears after payment; (c) Park Way / Lago Sul 'private house rental' via WhatsApp with PIX deposit — house doesn't exist, seller blocks your number; (d) hotel overbooking for Independência / Réveillon — Plano Piloto hotels oversell the peak week then 'relocate' paying guests to Taguatinga or Águas Claras (20–30 km from Plano Piloto) the night of arrival; (e) fake 'Brasília tourism board approved rental' Instagram accounts — no such approval body exists (SETURC is the official tourism office but does NOT approve individual rentals); (f) 'government-floor private apartment with Esplanada view R$2,500/night' — most Setor Hoteleiro (SHS / SHN) apartments have no Esplanada view and R$400–R$600/night is the legitimate range; (g) Réveillon 'Pontão VIP reserved beach-spot R$500 per person' — the Pontão waterfront is PUBLIC federal property; no reservation legitimately exists; (h) 'all-inclusive Esplanada civil-military parade viewing R$350 per person' — the Sep 7 parade is free public viewing.

For travelers: (1) BOOK accommodation 6–9 months ahead for peak dates (Sep 7, Dec 28–Jan 3, new-presidency January) via RECOGNIZED hotel chains ONLY — reputable Plano Piloto: Meliá Brasil 21, Royal Tulip Alvorada, Grand Mercure Brasília Eixo Monumental, Brasília Palace Hotel, B Hotel Brasília, Windsor Plaza Brasília, Kubitschek Plaza Hotel; (2) Avoid Airbnb for these dates entirely — cancel-and-relist pattern is well-documented per Brazilian traveler reports; (3) Never PIX-transfer to Instagram / WhatsApp 'aluguel temporada' sellers — payment is IRREVERSIBLE with no recovery recourse (only use credit card via Booking.com / Expedia / hotels.com which offer chargeback protection); (4) confirm your hotel booking 72 hours before arrival via direct phone call (NOT email); if overbooking is mentioned, demand written confirmation of the alternate property + the hotel chain's transfer commitment in writing BEFORE leaving the original reservation; (5) the Independência parade (Sep 7 at 9 AM on the Esplanada dos Ministérios) is 100% free public viewing — arrive by 7 AM to secure a spot along the barricades; Refuse every 'all-inclusive parade viewing R$350' offer; (6) the Réveillon Pontão Lago Sul fireworks are free public viewing — arrive by 9 PM; Refuse every 'VIP reserved beach spot' offer; (7) for travelers staying in Brasília long-term, reputable apart-hotels (daily / weekly rates with hotel-grade service): Royalty Brasília, Manhattan Plaza, Kubitschek Plaza — all in Plano Piloto; (8) PROCON-DF 151 for booking fraud disputes; DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522. Book Brasília peak-date accommodation 6–9 months ahead via recognized hotel chains only — Meliá Brasil 21, Royal Tulip Alvorada, Grand Mercure Eixo Monumental, B Hotel Brasília, Kubitschek Plaza. Avoid Airbnb for Independência (Sep 7) and Réveillon entirely — the cancel-and-relist pattern is well-documented. NEVER PIX-transfer to Instagram or WhatsApp "aluguel temporada" sellers — PIX is IRREVERSIBLE; pay only by credit card via Booking.com or Expedia for chargeback protection. Confirm hotel 72 hours pre-arrival by phone (not email); the Sep 7 parade and Réveillon Pontão fireworks are FREE public viewing — refuse every "VIP reserved spot" upsell.
scams.avoidance: Book 6–9 months ahead via chains: Meliá / Royal Tulip / Grand Mercure / Kubitschek Plaza AVOID Airbnb for Independência + Réveillon; NEVER PIX-transfer to Instagram / WhatsApp Pay via CREDIT CARD on Booking.com / Expedia ONLY (chargeback protection) Sep 7 parade + Réveillon Pontão fireworks = FREE public viewing; REFUSE VIP upsells Confirm hotel 72hr pre-arrival by PHONE; PROCON-DF 151 for disputes
scams.location: Booking platforms, Airbnb / Instagram / WhatsApp 'aluguel temporada' sellers
scams.tldr: Peak-date Brasília accommodation (Independência Sep 7, Réveillon, presidential inaugurations) faces Airbnb cancel-and-relist fraud at 2.5x markup, irreversible WhatsApp/Instagram PIX deposits to nonexistent units, and hotel overbooking that "relocates" guests 20–30 km out to Taguatinga the night of arrival.

scams.name: Lago Paranoá / Pontão Sul Pickpocket & Phone-Snatch Ring
scams.description:
The Pontão do Lago Sul (Brasília's waterfront restaurant, bar, and sunset promenade on the southern shore of Lago Paranoá, 3 km from Plano Piloto across the Ponte Juscelino Kubitschek) is the city's default evening tourist destination — and 2025 shows a phone-snatch and pickpocket pattern mirroring the broader Brazilian urban-tourism risk.

The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Pontão promenade phone-snatch — tourists take sunset photos of the Ponte JK (Oscar Niemeyer's triple-arch bridge, Brasília's signature postcard view), a passing cyclist or motorbike rider snatches the phone held for the photo; (b) 'helpful local' offering to take your Pontão sunset photo — the 'helper' runs with the phone; (c) Pontão waterfront restaurant distraction — a vendor approaches your table with flowers / jewelry / trinkets while an accomplice lifts a handbag from the back of your chair (leave bag on lap or between feet, never on chair-back); (d) Ponte JK mid-span pedestrian walk phone-snatch — some tourists walk the JK bridge for photos (it's 1.2 km pedestrian lane); motorbike rider snatches from the cycle lane; (e) 'sunset cruise Lago Paranoá R$200 per person' — unlicensed Pontão speedboat operators with no life jackets / no Marinha registration; reputable sunset cruise via Escuna Lobão at Pontão R$80–R$120 per person (2 hours); (f) 'aplicativo fix' street approach near Pontão Uber pickup — 'your Uber app has an error, let me fix it on your phone' = phone-theft tactic; (g) at Pontão parking, 'safe parking R$40 per hour' offered by unofficial attendants — the Pontão has free public parking, paid only during Fri-Sat evenings via the municipal meter (Zona Azul R$3 per hour); (h) at Orla do Lago Paranoá walk-path near Hotel Nacional, after-dark robberies reported in 2025.

For travelers: (1) at Pontão sunset (the iconic Brasília experience), take photos QUICKLY from the promenade or a reputable restaurant's terrace then STOW phone; do NOT hold phone visibly while walking the cycle-path edge; (2) Refuse every 'photo helper' approach — use a selfie stick or ask a restaurant server for assistance; (3) at Pontão waterfront tables, keep handbags on your LAP or between your feet — Don't on the chair-back; Refuse every vendor approach with flowers / trinkets during meal; (4) for the Ponte JK photo, take it from the Pontão waterfront (you get a full side-view of the bridge + city skyline) — do NOT walk the pedestrian lane of the bridge itself (1.2 km with snatch risk); (5) for Pontão sunset cruises, book via Escuna Lobão R$80–R$120 at the Pontão kiosk (verify Marinha registration + life jackets BEFORE boarding); Refuse unlicensed speedboat R$200 offers; (6) at Pontão parking Fri-Sat evenings, use official municipal Zona Azul meter (R$3/hour) — Refuse 'safe parking R$40/hour' unofficial attendant offers; (7) Refuse every 'aplicativo fix' street approach near Uber pickup — no one should handle your phone other than you; (8) Avoid the Orla do Lago Paranoá walking path near Hotel Nacional after dark — use Uber for any transit after sunset in that area; (9) reputable Pontão restaurants: Veleiros (Google 4.4+), Quitinete, Asa Delta, Kobe, Berttô; reputable sunset bars: Sunset Café, Belini Bar; (10) DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522; Polícia Militar 190. At Pontão sunset, take photos quickly from the promenade or a reputable restaurant terrace then stow phone — never hold phone visibly while walking the cycle-path edge or Ponte JK pedestrian lane. Refuse every "photo helper" approach (use a selfie stick or restaurant server) and keep handbags on your lap or between feet at waterfront tables. Book sunset cruises ONLY via Escuna Lobão at the Pontão kiosk (R$80–R$120, verify Marinha registration and life jackets); refuse R$200 unlicensed-speedboat offers. Use the official Zona Azul meter (R$3/hr) for parking and refuse "safe parking R$40/hour" unofficial-attendant scams.
scams.avoidance: Photos QUICKLY from promenade then stow phone; never walk Ponte JK pedestrian lane REFUSE 'photo helper' approach; use selfie stick or restaurant server Handbag on LAP or between feet at Pontão tables; refuse every vendor interruption Sunset cruise via Escuna Lobão R$80–R$120 (verify Marinha + life jackets) Zona Azul meter R$3/hr for parking; DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522
scams.location: Pontão do Lago Sul, Ponte Juscelino Kubitschek, Orla do Lago Paranoá
scams.tldr: Phone-snatch crews target the Pontão do Lago Sul sunset promenade, Ponte JK pedestrian span, and waterfront restaurant tables — passing motorbike riders lift phones held for sunset photos, "helpful local" photo-takers run with the device, and unlicensed R$200 "sunset cruise" speedboats lack life jackets and Marinha registration.

scams.name: Brasília Uber Coordinated Scam & Cross-Superquadra Route Padding
scams.description:
Brasília's Plano Piloto grid (Asa Sul and Asa Norte, bisected by the Eixo Monumental) is uniquely confusing to non-residents — a pattern 2025 Uber drivers exploit via deliberate route-padding and cross-superquadra detours.

The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Uber route-padding — driver uses longer cross-superquadra routes (e.g. Asa Sul 108 to Asa Sul 308 via Eixo Rodoviário + W3 Sul rather than the direct L2 Sul) to inflate Uber's GPS-based fare; (b) 'endereço está errado' ('address is wrong') — driver claims your superquadra address doesn't exist and charges a R$30 'address search fee' mid-trip; (c) cross-Eixo Monumental detour — Plano Piloto L2 N-S direct routes are the cheapest; drivers route via Esplanada + Eixo Monumental to pad the fare 20–40%; (d) 'other passenger already in car' at pickup (the traveler reports Santarém coordinated-scam pattern transferred to BSB-Plano Piloto routes); (e) mid-trip 'meter / app failed — R$100 cash' demand; (f) driver asking to 'see your card to confirm Uber payment' — card skimming; (g) cross-sector detour on BSB-to-Asa-Sul route — instead of direct Via W3 Sul / L2 Sul, driver routes via Estrada Parque Núcleo Bandeirante (padding fare 30%+); (h) late-night Asa Norte destination 'is dangerous' claim — driver offers to 'take you to a safer hotel' that pays a kickback; (i) 'night surcharge R$80' demand at trip end (Uber has no night surcharge in Brazil); (j) at Eixo Monumental tourist zone drop-offs, driver claiming 'parking is impossible here, pay R$20 extra for stopping' — there is no such surcharge.

For travelers: (1) BEFORE entering the Uber, OPEN Google Maps in split-screen with Uber and set your destination — know the direct route so you can detect padding; Plano Piloto's most direct routes are typically via the L2 Sul, L2 Norte, Eixo Rodoviário, or the Via S1 (Lago Sul); (2) VERIFY driver name + plate + photo match the in-app profile BEFORE entering — cancel + rebook if mismatched; (3) Don't share an Uber with an 'other passenger' already present at pickup (unless you explicitly booked UberPool); (4) Don't hand your credit or debit card to any driver for any reason — payment is ONLY via in-app card or cash at trip end; (5) Refuse every mid-trip 'meter / app broke — R$100 cash' demand — Uber Brazil uses GPS pricing, the in-app price is final; (6) Refuse every 'address is wrong R$30 search fee' — the driver can enter a different nearby address in-app for no extra cost; (7) Refuse 'your hotel is dangerous, let me take you elsewhere' — never allow destination redirect; (8) Refuse every 'night surcharge' / 'parking impossible R$20 extra' demand — these don't exist in Uber Brazil; (9) for travelers, prefer Uber Black or 99 Premium for slightly higher cost (R$10–R$20 more per trip) — drivers are more consistent + vehicles are sedans not hatchbacks — genuinely more comfortable for longer Plano Piloto rides; (10) DEATUR Brasília +55 61 3362 5522; Uber in-app 24/7 safety button. Open Google Maps in split-screen with Uber and set your destination BEFORE entering the car — know the direct route (L2 Sul, L2 Norte, Eixo Rodoviário, or Via S1) so you can detect cross-superquadra padding. Verify driver name, plate, and photo against the in-app profile before entering; never share an Uber with an "other passenger" already present unless you booked UberPool. Refuse every mid-trip "meter broke / R$100 cash" demand, every "address search fee," every "night surcharge," and every "parking impossible R$20" — none exist in Uber Brazil. Never hand a card to a driver, and use the in-app 24/7 safety button at the first redirect attempt.
scams.avoidance: Open Google Maps split-screen with Uber; know L2 Sul / L2 Norte direct routes VERIFY driver name + plate + photo match app BEFORE entering; cancel if mismatched NEVER share Uber with 'other passenger'; NEVER hand card to driver REFUSE every mid-trip 'cash top-up', 'address fee', 'night surcharge' demand Prefer Uber Black / 99 Premium for +R$10–R$20 (more consistent); DEATUR +55 61 3362 5522
scams.location: Plano Piloto superquadras, Asa Sul / Asa Norte, BSB airport pickup, Eixo Monumental
scams.tldr: Brasília Uber drivers exploit Plano Piloto's confusing superquadra grid via cross-superquadra detours (108→308 via Eixo Rodoviário rather than direct L2 Sul), fake "address search fees," and end-of-trip cash demands — no Uber Brazil "night surcharge" or "parking surcharge" exists.
